5515 The mirror of :func:`_added_line_numbers`: walks hunk headers 

5516 (``@@ -a,b +c,d @@``) counting ``-``/context lines in the OLD-file 

5517 coordinate system, so we can ask "which lines of the pre-fix file did this 

5518 change touch?". Used to verify a ``ruff --fix`` only removed/altered lines 

5519 the branch itself added (``git diff HEAD`` old-side == HEAD coordinates, 

5520 the same coordinates :func:`_added_line_numbers` yields for 

5521 ``origin/<base>...HEAD``). 

5522 """ 

5523 import re 

5524 

5525 removed: set[int] = set() 

5526 old_ln = 0 

5527 for line in diff_text.splitlines(): 

5528 if line.startswith("@@"): 

5529 m = re.search(r"-(\d+)", line) 

5530 old_ln = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0 

5531 continue 

5532 if line.startswith(("+++", "---")): 

5533 continue 

5534 if line.startswith("-"): 

5535 removed.add(old_ln) 

5536 old_ln += 1 

5537 elif line.startswith("+"): 

5538 continue # new-only line — does not advance the old-file counter 

5539 else: 

5540 old_ln += 1 # context line 

5541 return removed 

5542 

5543 

5544def _strip_own_added_fixable_lint( 

5545 target_repo: Path, base_ref: str, py_files: list[str], iso: list[str] 

5546) -> None: 

5547 """Auto-fix the F-class nits in :data:`_OWN_LINE_FIXABLE_CODES`, but ONLY the 

5548 ones whose EVERY violation sits on a line THIS branch added — decided by line 

5549 number, not text. 

5550 

5551 ``base_ref`` is an ALREADY-RESOLVED ref (``_changed_py_lint_scope`` resolves 

5552 it once via ``_resolve_diff_base``) — never a bare branch name to be 

5553 re-prefixed here. One resolution for the whole pre-PR lint path means the 

5554 file list, the added-line hunks and the residual check can never disagree 

5555 about which base they are measuring against. 

5556 

5557 Per file: compute the branch's added new-file line numbers (diff hunks vs 

5558 ``<base_ref>...HEAD``); ask ruff for the violations as JSON (their row 

5559 numbers, WITHOUT fixing) in ONE probe while the working tree still equals 

5560 HEAD (so probe rows and diff rows share a coordinate system); then, for each 

5561 candidate code independently, fix it ONLY IF every violation of that code is 

5562 a branch-added row. A code with even one violation on a pre-existing line is 

5563 dropped for this file (a possibly load-bearing side-effect import / a var the 

5564 dev didn't add is never silently mutated; the dev loop / CI handles it). 

5565 

5566 Codes are gated INDEPENDENTLY — a pre-existing F841 must not block removing 

5567 the dev's own newly-added F401. Fixes are then applied in a single 

5568 ``ruff --fix`` pass over just the cleared codes. ``--unsafe-fixes`` is added 

5569 only when a code needing it (F841) survives the gate. 

5570 

5571 Because a single ``ruff --fix`` pass is ITERATIVE (fixing one violation can 

5572 expose another and fix it too, on a line the input gate never evaluated), a 

5573 RESULT CHECK follows every fix: the applied change is diffed against HEAD and 

5574 the file is reverted whole if the fix removed/altered any line the branch did 

5575 NOT add. The input gate is thus an optimisation; the result check is the 

5576 load-bearing safety guarantee. Best-effort; never raises. 

5577 """ 

5578 import json 

5579 import subprocess 

5580 

5581 def _run(args: list[str], timeout: int = 120) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str] | None: 

5582 try: 

5583 return subprocess.run( 

5584 args, 

5585 cwd=str(target_repo), 

5586 capture_output=True, 

5587 text=True, 

5588 check=False, 

5589 timeout=timeout, 

5590 ) 

5591 except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError): 

5592 return None 

5593 

5594 select_all = ",".join(_OWN_LINE_FIXABLE_CODES) 

5595 for f in py_files: 

5596 diff = _run(["git", "diff", f"{base_ref}...HEAD", "--", f]) 

5597 if diff is None or diff.returncode != 0: 

5598 continue 

5599 added = _added_line_numbers(diff.stdout) 

5600 # All candidate violations (code + line number) in the CURRENT (committed) 

5601 # file — one probe, no fix yet, so every row is in HEAD's coordinates. 

5602 probe = _run( 

5603 [ 

5604 "uv", 

5605 "run", 

5606 "ruff", 

5607 "check", 

5608 "--select", 

5609 select_all, 

5610 "--output-format", 

5611 "json", 

5612 *iso, 

5613 f, 

5614 ], 

5615 timeout=120, 

5616 ) 

5617 if probe is None or not probe.stdout.strip(): 

5618 continue 

5619 try: 

5620 violations = json.loads(probe.stdout) 

5621 except (ValueError, TypeError): 

5622 continue 

5623 # rows_by_code[code] = {row numbers of that code's violations in this file} 

5624 rows_by_code: dict[str, set[int]] = {} 

5625 for v in violations: 

5626 if not isinstance(v, dict): 

5627 continue 

5628 code = v.get("code") 

5629 row = v.get("location", {}).get("row") 

5630 if code in _OWN_LINE_FIXABLE_CODES and row is not None: 

5631 rows_by_code.setdefault(code, set()).add(int(row)) 

5632 # A code is clearable iff it HAS violations here and every one is on a 

5633 # branch-added line. Codes are independent — one dropped code never 

5634 # blocks another. 

5635 clearable = [c for c, rows in rows_by_code.items() if rows and rows <= added] 

5636 if not clearable: 

5637 continue 

5638 fix_args = ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "--fix"] 

5639 if any(_OWN_LINE_FIXABLE_CODES[c] for c in clearable): 

5640 fix_args.append("--unsafe-fixes") 

5641 fix_args += ["--select", ",".join(sorted(clearable)), *iso, f] 

5642 _run(fix_args, timeout=180) 

5643 

5644 # RESULT CHECK (not just an input gate): a single ``ruff --fix`` pass is 

5645 # ITERATIVE — resolving one violation can create/expose another and fix 

5646 # THAT too within the same invocation, on a line the per-code gate never 

5647 # evaluated. E.g. removing a branch-added unused local (``x = os``, F841) 

5648 # orphans a PRE-EXISTING ``import os``, and with F401 co-selected ruff 

5649 # then deletes that pre-existing import (adversarial review, PR #105). 

5650 # So verify the APPLIED change touched ONLY branch-added lines: diff the 

5651 # fixed tree against HEAD and require every HEAD line it removed/altered 

5652 # to be a branch-added line. If the fix reached a pre-existing line, 

5653 # revert the whole file — the dev loop / CI handles it, we never ship a 

5654 # silent mutation of code the branch didn't author. 

5655 post = _run(["git", "diff", "HEAD", "--", f]) 

5656 if post is not None and post.returncode == 0 and post.stdout.strip(): 

5657 touched_head_lines = _removed_line_numbers(post.stdout) 

5658 if not (touched_head_lines <= added): 

5659 _run(["git", "checkout", "HEAD", "--", f]) 

5660 

5661 

5662def _open_pr_for_story( 

5663 story: StoryRecord, app_config: AppConfig, software_factory_root: Path 

5664) -> int | None: 

5665 """Push the feature branch and open a PR via the ``gh`` CLI (both chains). 

5666 

5667 Returns the PR number on success, ``None`` on any failure. Failures are 

5668 swallowed — the chain still transitions to ``PR_OPEN`` and the operator 

5669 can open the PR by hand from the (already-pushed) branch. 

5670 

5671 Uses ``gh`` rather than pygithub because the chain runs locally with 

5672 ``gh auth login`` already configured; no extra token plumbing needed. 

5673 

5674 Pushes from the per-story worktree (same one the writing persona ran in) 

5675 rather than the source repo — that's where the branch's HEAD is. 

5676 """ 

5677 import subprocess 

5678 

5679 target_repo = _writing_worktree(app_config, software_factory_root, story) 

5680 base = app_config.default_branch or "main" 

5681 branch = story.github_branch 

5682 if story.chain_kind == "docs": 

5683 title = f"docs(context): {story.title}" 

5684 summary_line = "Canonical context files added/updated." 

5685 else: 

5686 title = f"feat({story.scope or 'app'}): {story.title}" 

5687 summary_line = ( 

5688 "Code + tests written by the dev persona, approved by the reviewer " 

5689 "and docs-enforcer gates." 

5690 ) 

5691 body = ( 

5692 f"Generated by the factory {story.chain_kind} chain for story " 

5693 f"#{story.github_issue_number}.\n\n" 

5694 f"Branch: `{branch}`\n" 

5695 f"Story slug: `{story.slug}`\n" 

5696 f"Direction: `{story.direction_id}`\n\n" 

5697 f"{summary_line} The end-of-tick auto-merge worker merges this PR " 

5698 f"when its gates pass (factory_settings.yaml::auto_merge)." 

5699 ) 

5700 try: 

5701 # Sync with the base before opening the PR. Sibling stories merge 

5702 # continuously, so a branch cut earlier in the day is stale by PR 

5703 # time and its PR arrives conflicted (three operator hand-merges on 

5704 # 2026-06-11). A clean auto-merge here keeps the PR mergeable; on 

5705 # conflict we abort and proceed — the PR opens conflicted and a 

5706 # human resolves it (never silently auto-resolve). Best-effort: a 

5707 # fetch/merge failure must not block PR creation. 

5708 try: 

5709 subprocess.run( 

5710 ["git", "fetch", "origin", base], 

5711 cwd=str(target_repo), 

5712 check=False, 

5713 capture_output=True, 

5714 timeout=60, 

5715 ) 

5716 base_merge = subprocess.run( 

5717 ["git", "merge", "--no-edit", f"origin/{base}"], 

5718 cwd=str(target_repo), 

5719 capture_output=True, 

5720 text=True, 

5721 timeout=120, 

5722 ) 

5723 if base_merge.returncode != 0: 

5724 subprocess.run( 

5725 ["git", "merge", "--abort"], 

5726 cwd=str(target_repo), 

5727 check=False, 

5728 capture_output=True, 

5729 timeout=60, 

5730 ) 

5731 except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError): 

5732 pass 

5733 

5734 # Refresh + PRUNE remote-tracking refs before the lease push. If the 

5735 # feature branch was deleted on origin since this worktree last 

5736 # fetched (e.g. an operator closed a conflicted PR with 

5737 # --delete-branch), the stale local tracking ref makes 

5738 # --force-with-lease reject with "stale info" and PR creation 

5739 # silently fails (story 56, 2026-07-18). A plain single-branch fetch 

5740 # does NOT remove the stale ref — only --prune does. 

5741 subprocess.run( 

5742 ["git", "fetch", "--prune", "origin"], 

5743 cwd=str(target_repo), 

5744 check=False, 

5745 capture_output=True, 

5746 timeout=120, 

5747 ) 

5748 # Auto-format the story's own changed .py files (ruff --fix + format) 

5749 # and commit any fixes BEFORE pushing. Trivial lint/format nits (import 

5750 # sort, missing trailing newline) that the dev persona leaves would 

5751 # otherwise fail GitHub's required lint check — which the chain's 

5752 # pre-merge gates (tests-green / smoke / staging) do NOT cover — and, 

5753 # via the auto-merge-enabled path, strand the story at deploy_pending 

5754 # (found 2026-07-21 on the first factory self-edit, PR #57). Best-effort 

5755 # and scoped to changed files, so it never reformats unrelated code and 

5756 # never blocks PR creation. 

5757 _autoformat_changed_py_before_pr(target_repo, base, app_config) 

5758 # Push the branch; gh pr create needs an upstream ref. 

5759 # --force-with-lease: story branches are factory-owned and single- 

5760 # writer, and origin may hold STALE commits from abandoned earlier 

5761 # attempts (pre-rewrite runs pushed work-preservation commits). The 

5762 # locally approved state is authoritative; a plain push gets a 

5763 # non-fast-forward rejection against that stale history (story 5, 

5764 # 2026-06-11). The lease still aborts if origin moved unexpectedly 

5765 # since our last fetch. 

5766 subprocess.run( 

5767 ["git", "push", "--force-with-lease", "-u", "origin", str(branch)], 

5768 cwd=str(target_repo), 

5769 check=True, 

5770 capture_output=True, 

5771 timeout=60, 

5772 ) 

5773 # Emit push signal — best-effort. 

5774 try: 

5775 from factory.manager.signals import write_git_event as _wge 

5776 

5777 _wge( 

5778 kind="push", 

5779 story_id=story.id, 

5780 worktree_path=str(target_repo), 

5781 result="ok", 

5782 software_factory_root=software_factory_root, 

5783 ) 

5784 except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 

5785 pass 

5786 

5787 proc = subprocess.run( 

5788 [ 

5789 "gh", 

5790 "pr", 

5791 "create", 

5792 "--repo", 

5793 app_config.repo, 

5794 "--base", 

5795 base, 

5796 "--head", 

5797 str(branch), 

5798 "--title", 

5799 title, 

5800 "--body", 

5801 body, 

5802 ], 

5803 cwd=str(target_repo), 

5804 check=True, 

5805 capture_output=True, 

5806 text=True, 

5807 timeout=60, 

5808 ) 

5809 except ( 

5810 subprocess.CalledProcessError, 

5811 subprocess.TimeoutExpired, 

5812 FileNotFoundError, 

5813 ) as _push_exc: 

5814 # A PR may already exist for this branch (e.g. the story re-reached 

5815 # PR_OPEN after a CI-fix / review re-dispatch). `gh pr create` then 

5816 # exits non-zero with "already exists" — but the story genuinely HAS a 

5817 # PR, so RELINK it: look up the existing PR number and return it. 

5818 # Without this, github_pr_number stays None and the auto-merge / CI-fix 

5819 # machinery can never act on the existing PR (it sits orphaned forever). 

5820 stderr = getattr(_push_exc, "stderr", "") or "" 

5821 if isinstance(_push_exc, subprocess.CalledProcessError) and "already exists" in stderr: 

5822 try: 

5823 existing = subprocess.run( 

5824 [ 

5825 "gh", 

5826 "pr", 

5827 "view", 

5828 str(branch), 

5829 "--repo", 

5830 app_config.repo, 

5831 "--json", 

5832 "number", 

5833 "-q", 

5834 ".number", 

5835 ], 

5836 cwd=str(target_repo), 

5837 capture_output=True, 

5838 text=True, 

5839 timeout=30, 

5840 ) 

5841 num = (existing.stdout or "").strip() 

5842 if existing.returncode == 0 and num.isdigit(): 

5843 try: 

5844 from factory.manager.signals import write_git_event as _wge_relink 

5845 

5846 _wge_relink( 

5847 kind="pr_open", 

5848 story_id=story.id, 

5849 pr_number=int(num), 

5850 result="relinked", 

5851 software_factory_root=software_factory_root, 

5852 ) 

5853 except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 

5854 pass 

5855 return int(num) 

5856 except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError): 

5857 pass 

5858 # Emit error signal — best-effort. 

5859 try: 

5860 from factory.manager.signals import write_git_event as _wge_err 

5861 

5862 _wge_err( 

5863 kind="pr_open", 

5864 story_id=story.id, 

5865 worktree_path=str(target_repo), 

5866 result="error", 

5867 error=repr(_push_exc), 

5868 software_factory_root=software_factory_root, 

5869 ) 

5870 except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 

5871 pass 

5872 return None 

5873 

5874 # gh prints the PR URL on stdout; parse the trailing digits. 

5875 url = (proc.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-1] if proc.stdout else "" 

5876 # URL shape: https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/pull/<n> 

5877 m = re.search(r"/pull/(\d+)$", url) 

5878 pr_num = int(m.group(1)) if m else None 

5879 

5880 # Emit pr_open signal — best-effort. 

5881 try: 

5882 from factory.manager.signals import write_git_event as _wge_pr 

5883 

5884 _wge_pr( 

5885 kind="pr_open", 

5886 story_id=story.id, 

5887 pr_number=pr_num, 

5888 result="ok", 

5889 software_factory_root=software_factory_root, 

5890 ) 

5891 except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 

5892 pass 

5893 

5894 return pr_num 

5895

5898# helpers used by the orchestrator

5902def find_direction_for_story(story: StoryRecord, software_factory_root: Path) -> Direction | None: 

5903 """Look up the parsed Direction record for a story (by direction_id).""" 

5904 for dpath in list_direction_dirs(story.app, software_factory_root): 

5905 if dpath.name.startswith(f"{story.direction_id}-"): 

5906 return parse_direction_dir( 

5907 story.app, dpath, software_factory_root=software_factory_root 

5908 ) 

5909 return None 

5910 

5911 

5912# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 

5913# Phase 5 — handle_deploy 

5914# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 

5915 

5916 

5917def _lookup_merged_sha(app: str, pr_number: int, db_path: Path) -> str | None: 

5918 """Return the head_sha of the most-recent merged ``merge_actions`` row. 

5919 

5920 Returns ``None`` when no merge has been recorded for this PR yet. 

5921 Imported lazily to avoid a chain → auto_merge import cycle. 

5922 """ 

5923 from factory.chain.auto_merge import MergeActionRecord 

5924 

5925 eng = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{db_path}", echo=False) 

5926 SQLModel.metadata.create_all(eng) 

5927 with Session(eng) as session: 

5928 row = session.exec( 

5929 select(MergeActionRecord) 

5930 .where( 

5931 MergeActionRecord.app == app, 

5932 MergeActionRecord.pr_number == pr_number, 

5933 MergeActionRecord.merged == True, # noqa: E712 

5934 ) 

5935 .order_by(MergeActionRecord.id.desc()) # type: ignore[union-attr] 

5936 ).first() 

5937 if row is None: 

5938 return None 

5939 return row.head_sha 

5940 

5941 

5942def _close_issues_on_deploy( 

5943 story: StoryRecord, 

5944 app_config: AppConfig, 

5945 software_factory_root: Path, 

5946 db: Path, 

5947 github_client: Any, 

5948 dry_run: bool, 

5949) -> None: 

5950 """Close a deployed story's GH issue + its direction tracker (when all 

5951 siblings are deployed). Best-effort; never raises. Fixes the accumulation 

5952 of open story/tracker issues for already-shipped work (audit 2026-07-18). 

5953 

5954 ``github_client`` is ``None`` on every real call today: the orchestrator's 

5955 ``_invoke_handler`` never passes one to ``handle_deploy``, so this used to 

5956 silently no-op on every deploy (nothing ever closed). When not 

5957 ``dry_run``, self-construct a client via the shared 

5958 ``factory.providers.github.build_github_client`` helper — the same one 

5959 ``factory.cli._ensure_github_client`` uses — rather than requiring the 

5960 caller to thread one through. Missing token is swallowed to a warning: 

5961 bookkeeping must never break deploy. 

5962 """ 

5963 if dry_run: 

5964 return 

5965 client = github_client 

5966 if client is None: 

5967 from factory.providers.github import build_github_client 

5968 

5969 client = build_github_client() 

5970 if client is None: 

5971 _logger.warning( 

5972 "deploy: no GitHub token available (GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN/" 

5973 "gh auth token) — skipping auto-close of story %s issue(s)", 

5974 story.id, 

5975 ) 

5976 return 

5977 try: 

5978 from factory.directions.tracker_issue import ( 

5979 close_story_issue, 

5980 maybe_close_tracker_issue, 

5981 ) 

5982 

5983 close_story_issue(story, app_config, client) 

5984 if story.direction_id: 

5985 maybe_close_tracker_issue( 

5986 story.direction_id, 

5987 app_config, 

5988 client, 

5989 software_factory_root=software_factory_root, 

5990 db_path=db, 

5991 ) 

5992 except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 - bookkeeping must never break deploy 

5993 pass 

5994 

5995 

5996def handle_deploy( 

5997 story: StoryRecord, 

5998 app_config: AppConfig, 

5999 software_factory_root: Path, 

6000 *, 

6001 dry_run: bool = False, 

6002 db_path: Path | None = None, 

6003 fixture_step_outputs: list[tuple[int, str, str]] | None = None, 

6004 fixture_step_outputs_by_phase: dict[str, list[tuple[int, str, str]]] | None = None, 

6005 github_client: Any = None, 

6006) -> HandlerResult: 

6007 """Drive the post-merge deploy for ``story``. 

6008 

6009 Pre-conditions: story.state == DEPLOY_PENDING and 

6010 ``story.github_pr_number`` is set. The handler delegates to the deploy 

6011 orchestrator, then flips the story state to DEPLOYED on success, 

6012 BLOCKED_DEPLOY_FAILED on hard failure, or DEPLOYED with skip marker 

6013 when the app has ``deploy.enabled=false``. 

6014 """ 

6015 from factory.chain.state_machine import ( 

6016 EVENT_DEPLOY_FAILED, 

6017 EVENT_DEPLOY_SKIPPED, 

6018 EVENT_DEPLOY_STARTED, 

6019 EVENT_DEPLOY_SUCCEEDED, 

6020 ) 

6021 from factory.deploy.orchestrator import deploy_post_merge 

6022 

6023 db = db_path or (software_factory_root / "state" / "factory.db") 

6024 if story.state != StoryState.DEPLOY_PENDING.value: 

6025 return HandlerResult( 

6026 next_state=StoryState(story.state), 

6027 error=f"handle_deploy called from non-deploy_pending state {story.state!r}", 

6028 ) 

6029 if story.github_pr_number is None: 

6030 # No PR number means we can't deploy a specific SHA; treat as skip. 

6031 story.state = advance(story, EVENT_DEPLOY_SKIPPED).value 

6032 story.error = "deploy_skipped_no_pr_number" 

6033 persist_story(story, db) 

6034 return HandlerResult(next_state=StoryState(story.state), error=story.error) 

6035 

6036 # If deploy is disabled, transition to DEPLOYED with skip marker. The 

6037 # orchestrator's deploy_post_merge already records the action row with 

6038 # status="skipped"; we just observe the result here and short-circuit 

6039 # the state. 

6040 if not effective_deploy_enabled(app_config, software_factory_root): 

6041 story.state = advance(story, EVENT_DEPLOY_SKIPPED).value 

6042 persist_story(story, db) 

6043 # This early-return short-circuits before the ``deploy_post_merge`` 

6044 # call below, so the reachable-but-only-via-that-path close call a 

6045 # few lines down never runs for apps with deploy.enabled=false 

6046 # (e.g. sacrifice) — the story reaches DEPLOYED here but its GH 

6047 # issues never closed (audit 2026-07-18). Close them here too. 

6048 _close_issues_on_deploy( 

6049 story, app_config, software_factory_root, db, github_client, dry_run 

6050 ) 

6051 return HandlerResult( 

6052 next_state=StoryState(story.state), 

6053 payload={"skipped": True, "reason": "deploy_disabled_in_config"}, 

6054 ) 

6055 

6056 # Look up the merged_sha from the ``merge_actions`` row this PR 

6057 # produced. We pick the most-recent ``merged=True`` row for this PR. 

6058 # If no row exists, refuse to dispatch — deploying without knowing 

6059 # the SHA we just merged is a category error (we'd be deploying an 

6060 # unspecified commit). The webhook path inserts a ``merge_actions`` 

6061 # row at PR-merged time, and tests can seed one via 

6062 # ``factory.chain.auto_merge.MergeActionRecord`` directly. 

6063 # 

6064 # IMPORTANT: do this BEFORE advancing to deploy_in_progress so the 

6065 # story stays in DEPLOY_PENDING (recoverable) when the SHA isn't 

6066 # there yet. Otherwise we'd advance to deploy_in_progress, leaving 

6067 # the chain with no way to resume that PR's deploy. 

6068 merged_sha = _lookup_merged_sha(story.app, story.github_pr_number, db) 

6069 if merged_sha is None: 

6070 # Allow dry-run a fallback so unit tests that don't seed a 

6071 # merge_actions row can still exercise the success/failure paths. 

6072 if dry_run: 

6073 merged_sha = "pending-sha" 

6074 else: 

6075 err = f"merge SHA not recorded for PR {story.github_pr_number}" 

6076 story.error = err 

6077 persist_story(story, db) 

6078 return HandlerResult( 

6079 next_state=StoryState(story.state), 

6080 error=err, 

6081 ) 

6082 

6083 # Mark started. 

6084 story.state = advance(story, EVENT_DEPLOY_STARTED).value 

6085 persist_story(story, db) 

6086 

6087 action = deploy_post_merge( 

6088 story.app, 

6089 story.github_pr_number, 

6090 merged_sha, 

6091 software_factory_root, 

6092 dry_run=dry_run, 

6093 fixture_step_outputs=fixture_step_outputs, 

6094 fixture_step_outputs_by_phase=fixture_step_outputs_by_phase, 

6095 github_client=github_client, 

6096 db_path=db, 

6097 ) 

6098 

6099 if action.success: 

6100 story.state = advance(story, EVENT_DEPLOY_SUCCEEDED).value 

6101 story.error = None 

6102 persist_story(story, db) 

6103 _close_issues_on_deploy( 

6104 story, app_config, software_factory_root, db, github_client, dry_run 

6105 ) 

6106 return HandlerResult( 

6107 next_state=StoryState(story.state), 

6108 payload={"deploy_action": True, "success": True}, 

6109 ) 

6110 

6111 # Failure (or skipped via pre-flight). If pre-flight skipped (e.g. 

6112 # mode_blocks_deploy), route to DEPLOYED with the marker rather than 

6113 # BLOCKED — the operator hasn't actually deployed yet but the story 

6114 # isn't blocked by code quality. 

6115 if action.error and action.error in { 

6116 "mode_blocks_deploy", 

6117 "deploy_disabled_in_config", 

6118 }: 

6119 story.state = advance(story, EVENT_DEPLOY_SKIPPED).value 

6120 story.error = action.error 

6121 persist_story(story, db) 

6122 # deploy_disabled_in_config still reaches DEPLOYED — the story is done 

6123 # from the chain's perspective, so close its issues too. 

6124 _close_issues_on_deploy( 

6125 story, app_config, software_factory_root, db, github_client, dry_run 

6126 ) 

6127 return HandlerResult( 

6128 next_state=StoryState(story.state), 

6129 payload={"skipped": True, "reason": action.error}, 

6130 ) 

6131 

6132 story.state = advance(story, EVENT_DEPLOY_FAILED).value 

6133 story.error = action.error or "deploy_failed_unknown" 

6134 persist_story(story, db) 

6135 return HandlerResult( 

6136 next_state=StoryState(story.state), 

6137 payload={ 

6138 "deploy_action": True, 

6139 "rolled_back": action.rolled_back, 

6140 "p0_issue_number": action.p0_issue_number, 

6141 }, 

6142 error=story.error, 

6143 )
